intent_scope.boundary: Assertions reconstruct the observable narrative requirements for review. They were not supplied to the historical renderer and cannot become benchmark evidence.

assertions.requirement: Exactly two adult subjects are visibly represented in each selected panel.
Soren and Sigrid remain visually differentiated by declared hair/wardrobe markers.
Each panel reads its declared movement, support, or threshold action.
No child image, child likeness, or child-reference input appears in the linked historical render records.

decision_rule: An archival internal-research selection may pass only if all hard assertions pass in review. It remains non-commercial and does not establish a future renderer's capability.
prohibited_inferences: No final art or commercial-release claim.
No canonical 3D set or animation-shot claim.
